blocking_findings.summary: The typed SentimentFeatures slot can claim non-degraded availability when a required sentiment model failed or was unavailable.
blocking_findings.evidence: agents/executor_helpers/sentiment_helper.py:444-452 derives missing/degraded state only from window availability, temporal rejections, unscored evidence and total absence of eligible evidence. It does not inspect finbert_result, vader_result or fear_greed_result status/coverage. Lines 455-459 record all configured model versions regardless of whether that model produced data. The independent probe supplied eligible evidence, a valid FinBERT chunk score, vader_result status ERROR with zero chunks, and a FinBERT-only fusion result; the resulting typed slot reported degraded=false, degraded_flags=(), missing_flags=(), aggregate_7d=0.7 while advertising the VADER model version.
blocking_findings.contract_violation: Stage 06 requires explainable missing data and a compact SentimentFeatures output with trustworthy missing/degraded flags and model provenance. Stage 08 is specified to consume SentimentFeatures from State, so a healthy-looking typed slot must not hide a missing model merely because a partial aggregate can be computed.

non_blocking_findings.summary: The private _retrieve_social_data helper retains a legacy no-context branch.
non_blocking_findings.assessment: The actual MCP call_tool entry now validates ForecastContext/run_id unconditionally before dispatch, and repository search found no non-test caller of the private helper. Removing the private legacy branch would further reduce misuse risk but is not blocking for the reviewed runtime path.

non_blocking_findings.summary: Live providers and external trace export remain unverified by design.
non_blocking_findings.assessment: The reviewed evidence is offline and deterministic under the explicit no-network/no-external-write constraints. This is correctly disclosed and is not a scientific performance claim.

required_rework.requirement: Derive model availability and degradation from the validated FinBERT, VADER and fusion results, not only from window evidence. A missing/error/NO_DATA required model or failed fusion must be explicit in the typed slot's missing/degraded flags and availability/provenance. Propagate the selected attempt's coverage/quality degradation into sentiment_features before Shared State commit. Add helper and full-agent sentinels for one-model failure, fusion failure and low coverage, proving partial aggregates may remain available but the slot is never marked healthy.

review_blockers: The current Attempt 2 typed SentimentFeatures contract can conceal required-model failure from downstream monthly forecast consumers.

resolved_findings.evidence: Every present published_at/effective_from field is parsed independently and any invalid or post-as_of value rejects the evidence. The exact future-effective_from counterexample passed.
Individual raw chunks are point-in-time filtered before canonical grouping and grouped documents are revalidated. The exact same-URL past/future counterexample passed and future text was absent.
MCP call_tool now requires ForecastContext/run_id before every dispatch. The exact missing-identity counterexample failed closed and did not invoke retrieval.
The immutable 40-character FinBERT commit is accurately identified as git-revision.

A single exported MappingProxy identity drives helper and agent lifecycle/trace/progress metadata and emits stage=06, revision=1, attempt=2, agent=sentiment and implementation_version=stage06-r1-a2. The three exact identity sentinels passed.
Private payload exclusion, eight measured boundaries, child-span failure sanitization and immutable local FinBERT/VADER provenance remain intact in Attempt 2.
